name: ChatGPT Codex (chatgpt.com/codex)
description: OpenAI Codex engineering-agent surface on chatgpt.com — task dashboard, Codex Cloud, environments, connectors, usage/credits. Distinct from plain ChatGPT chat; same SPA shell + same /backend-api host (Codex namespace /wham/* + conversation-bound task SSE).
author: ui2api capability package
siteVersion: cluster unified-184 (client-bootstrap); shared app shell (entry.client-*, conversation-small-*); logged-out /codex = Contentful marketing page; auth-gated Codex SPA = 73 routes in the embedded React Router manifest

transport.protocol: JSON REST over https://chatgpt.com/backend-api (sampled by auth via /api/auth/session) plus fetch-based SSE (text/event-stream, [DONE], last-event-id replay) on the task stream

namespaces.rest: /wham/* (tasks, turns, environments, machines, github/gitlab, usage/rate-limits, analytics, settings, workspace-messages) + /share/codex/task_samples

auth.tokenOrigin: same-origin /api/auth/session (same chatgpt.com cookie jar as plain ChatGPT)
auth.sentinel: task creation requires a Sentinel chat-requirements token generated for mode codex_create_task_turn (OpenAI-Sentinel-Token, optional -Chat-Requirements-Token/-Turnstile-Token/-Proof-Token, OAI-Telemetry)

headers.x-openai-codex-window-type: codex-specific window tag (e.g. not_applicable in chat)

transport.streaming: SSE via a fetch-event-source-style helper in the auth bundle (4013494d/…): Accept text/event-stream, retry 1000ms, last-event-id for replay, [DONE] terminates. Stream payloads (JSON per data line): task_status | final_message | row | title; task statuses seen: created/running/finalizing.
transport.authOutcome: host-constrained static probe only — Bearer + exact sentinel header shapes and any cookie-localStorage set to be confirmed on first live capture (session.lock.json)

capabilities.name: Codex task create + stream
capabilities.description: Create a Codex task from the /codex composer and read the task/turn stream (POST /backend-api/wham/tasks {new_task, input_items} + SSE GET /backend-api/tasks/{task_id}/stream)
capabilities.method: ui-path (trusted input + send on the Codex composer, site's own handler) — wire documented for a later wire-first driver
capabilities.implementation: POST /wham/tasks body {new_task:{environment_id, branch, run_environment_in_qa_mode}, input_items:[{type:message, role:user, content:[{content_type:text, text}]}]} with Sentinel token (mode codex_create_task_turn) in additionalHeaders; SSE stream read off /tasks/{task_id}/stream with parent_conversation_id + message_id query; task_status/final_message/row/title JSON events, [DONE] terminator

capabilities.name: Task list / detail / lifecycle
capabilities.description: List, search, get, archive, cancel, fork, mark-read, recover Codex tasks via /wham/tasks*
capabilities.implementation: GET /wham/tasks (query limit/cursor/task_filter), GET /wham/tasks/list, GET /wham/tasks/search, GET /wham/tasks/{task_id}; POST /wham/tasks/{task_id}/archive|cancel|fork|mark_read|recover; GET /wham/task_suggestions/github/user_handle; GET /share/codex/task_samples

capabilities.name: Task turns & PRs
capabilities.description: Turn list/detail, logs, cancel, copy-git-apply, viewed, and pull-request create/update

capabilities.name: Environments & machines
capabilities.description: Sandbox environment CRUD + machine inventory for Codex tasks
capabilities.implementation: GET /wham/environments, /recent, /search, /with-creators; POST /wham/environments; PATCH|DELETE /wham/environments/{environment_id}; POST .../reset-cache; POST /wham/environments/test/{test_session_id}/command; GET /wham/machines

capabilities.name: GitHub / GitLab connectors
capabilities.description: Repo discovery, branch search, installations, code review + GitLab service-account config
capabilities.implementation: GET /wham/github/installations(/(events)? etc), GET /wham/github/repositories/*, GET /wham/github/branches/{repo_id}/search, POST /wham/github/repositories/{repo_id}/pull-requests/review, /wham/github/repositories/{repo_id}/pull-requests; POST /wham/github/installations/{installation_id}/repositories/{repo_id}/pull-request/{pr_number}/review (post variant); GitLab: /wham/gitlab/groups, /groups/{group_id}/webhook, /service-account-credential*

capabilities.name: Usage & credits
capabilities.description: Token/credit usage breakdowns, credit events, rate-limit reset credits

capabilities.name: Codex Cloud
capabilities.description: Codex Cloud SPA surface (universe/tasks/access/security/settings) + cloud task PR page
capabilities.implementation: SPA routes /codex/cloud, /codex/cloud/tasks, /codex/cloud/tasks/:taskId, /codex/cloud/tasks/:taskId/turns/:turnId/pr, /codex/cloud/access, /codex/cloud/security, /codex/cloud/settings, /codex/cloud/failwhale; cloud-specific REST prefix not separated in shared bundles — confirm on first live capture

capabilities.name: Codex CLI / desktop auth
capabilities.description: OAuth client config for the Codex CLI + desktop/install entrypoints
capabilities.implementation: GET /oauth/codex/client.json, GET /oauth/codex/:callbackId/client.json (device-code pairing, gate codex_device_code_auth); routes /codex/install.sh, /codex/install.ps1, /codex/desktop-auth, /codex/desktop-session, /codex/rosalind-download

auth.note: provider-catalog: chatgpt-web-codex kind=cookie (full ChatGPT Cookie header). Codex reuses the chatgpt.com login + cookie jar (/api/auth/session -> Authorization: Bearer). Bundles: Wham client K keys its base URL off the Authorization header -> https://chatgpt.com/backend-api; /wham/* namespace. Capture once headed (url https://chatgpt.com/codex), then fill session.lock.json.

permissions: requires a real logged-in chatgpt.com session (Codex gates: wham_access / codex_only / credit limits)
task creation additionally needs a Sentinel chat-requirements token (mode codex_create_task_turn) — driven by the site's own JS on the ui-path
anti-automation: Cloudflare challenge on cold fetch (see CAPABILITIES.md §7) + ChatGPT sentinel + /accounts/check/{version} tier gates once abuse signals appear
analysisMethod: static curl + 14 JS bundles (~12MB: conversation-small 5.3MB, auth/wham-client 2.3MB, shell 3.6MB, manifest 0.7MB + codex route chunks) + SSR client-bootstrap; Cloudflare challenge bypassed with full browser headers (HTTP 200); no browser launched; logged-out /codex only serves the marketing page
